NONE: › weak and unable to walk in a normal way, usually because you are old
（通常指因年老而）步履蹣跚的，走路搖搖晃晃的

example: a doddery old man
步履蹣跚的老人

NONE: › something that is very easy to do
舉手之勞，輕而易舉之事

example: The exam was a doddle.
這次考試太容易了。

NONE: › a solid shape that has twelve flat surfaces of equal size with five sides
十二面體（由十二個等面積的五邊形組成的多面體）
› used for describing music in which the twelve notes of the chromatic scale are used equally and each note has the same importance
十二音技巧；十二音音樂的

I or T: › [ I or T ] to avoid being hit by something by moving quickly to one side

NONE: › a clever, dishonest way of avoiding something
（巧妙而具欺騙性的）逃避

example: He dodged to avoid the hurtling bicycle.
他閃身躲過了疾馳而來的腳踏車。
The Senator dodged questions about his relationship with the actress.
參議員回避了關於他與那位女演員之間關係的問題。
They bought another car as a tax dodge (= a way to avoid paying tax).
爲了逃稅，他們又買了一輛汽車。

NONE: › a brand name for a small electric car driven for entertainment in a special closed space at a fair, etc., where the aim is to try to hit other cars
碰碰車
› a person who avoids doing what they should do
逃避者

example: a tax dodger
逃稅者

NONE: › dishonest
不誠實的，不懷好意的
› likely to fail or cause problems
不可靠的；有風險的
› likely to break or cause pain
可能要斷的；可能會痛苦的

example: a dodgy deal
不誠實的交易
They got involved with a dodgy businessman and lost all their savings.
他們遇到了一個奸商，結果把所有積蓄都賠進去了。
The weather might be a bit dodgy at this time of year.
每年的這個時候天氣都可能有些變化無常。
I can't come in to work today - I've got a bit of a dodgy stomach.
我今天不能來上班了——我的肚子有些不舒服。
It was a dodgy situation.
當時局面並不穩定。
Careful - that chair's a bit dodgy.
小心——那把椅子有些不穩。
Ever since the accident I've had this dodgy leg.
自從那次事故以後，我的腿就總是作痛。

NONE: › a large bird, unable to fly, that no longer exists
度度鳥（一種大型鳥類，不能飛翔，現已滅絕）
